claim: A start-up tail at 0xC000 or above vanishes when its own OUT to 0x7FFD maps the game's bank back there; pick a tail site below it that is write-first over the whole recording.

evidence.text: Default tail put below SP at 0xFF97 vanished (above 0xC000 its OUT 0x7FFD maps bank 0 back); choose_tail_addr refuses above 0xC000 only for 128K; nextboot.check caught it; fix --tail 0xA6C9 (write-first over the whole RZX).
evidence.quote: back and the tail vanishes (choose_tail_addr refuses >0xC000 only for 128K; nextboot.check catches it:

evidence.text: 128K start-up tail must end below 0xC000 (its 7FFD write remaps C000-FFFF); tail at 0x9F00.
